# Plugin supply chain

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: use only characters, modular shapes, color, and checkpoint motion. Every package face, screen, gate, and surface must be blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Octocat/Invertocat silhouette, wordmark, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a polished 2.5D animated-film still with cel-shaded reviewers, GitHub dark-mode atmosphere, contribution-grid texture, modular repository objects, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, and restrained depth. Use approximately 80% near-black or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple.

Show two animated software reviewers inspecting one versioned workflow package assembled from five different abstract modules. Move the package through six visually distinct but unlabeled checkpoints using fingerprint, seal, staged-lane, pulse, boundary, and return-path geometry before it reaches several teams. The visual POV is software supply-chain governance: one convenient bundle can affect many trust surfaces.

Place the scene on the left and keep the right 38% quiet for slide copy. No logos, mascots, generic package dashboard, words, letters, product UI, screenshots, interface panels, or watermarks.
